item.intoxicantes.cerveja.lore: The corner classic: strength for the job, hangover later.
item.intoxicantes.vinho.lore: Slow regeneration. A drink for those with time (and patience).
item.intoxicantes.hidromel.lore: Sweet and heavy: extra absorption to take a beating.
item.intoxicantes.cachaca.lore: Strong punch, wobbly legs. Drink before the shootout, not during.
item.intoxicantes.rum.lore: A rum belly never catches fire. Pirates know why.
item.intoxicantes.baseado.lore: Calm smoke: fall slow, worry less.
item.intoxicantes.maconha_seda.lore: Raw leaf: an ingredient for the mod recipes.
item.intoxicantes.opio.lore: Bitter sap: sickening and weakening. Raw material, not medicine.
item.intoxicantes.cocaina.lore: Mining turbo: dig absurdly fast, pay with exhaustion.
item.intoxicantes.heroina.lore: Full anesthesia: take damage like stone, walk like stone.
item.intoxicantes.lsd.lore: Reality is negotiable. Sees in the dark — mind the ledges.
item.intoxicantes.po_estelar.lore: Comet dust: fast and sharp, with hunger to pay.
item.intoxicantes.cogumelo_xamanico.lore: Ancient visions: see in the dark, float unplanned.
item.intoxicantes.nevoa_do_deserto.lore: Sand in the eyes, map in the mind. Just don't jump.
item.intoxicantes.raiz_de_sombra.lore: Heavy root: feather fall, string arms.
item.intoxicantes.cristal_de_euforia.lor: The explorer's combo: regenerate, speed up, jump high.
item.intoxicantes.extrato_cafeina.lore: Quick hands, quick feet. The shift's fuel.
